Setting the `HttpServerOptions` in `VertxHttpRecorder` didn't fix the issue. Instead, increasing the frame size passed to `WebSocketFrameDecoder` in `Handshake` worked for me.
Yes, I can take a look.

Found the place where the max frame size is hardcoded.

@nonconceptual I can add a new config param in `HttpConfiguration` but it isn't trivial how to pass the value to `Handshake` class.
